_note: Skeleton for docs/harness-bindings.json — the factory's OWN declaration of which law files it ships and where each one loads from, read by tests/test_harness_bindings.py (gate P29). Copy it into docs/ (the example itself is never read) and add a row per bound skill. THE REPO'S OWN skills/ DIRECTORY CANNOT BE THE SURFACE: a derivation sees only what EXISTS, and the property under test is that a load path is OWED — the repo skills/ directory is empty exactly when the factory has not yet created one, so a gate keyed on it returns the empty set and passes on the one case that motivated the finding. A declaration is the only form that can owe. Top level: `profile` (the declared factory parameter — the OpenCrabs profile name whose skills/ directory carries the load paths; declared once here, never hardcoded in the gate, so a second factory declares its own without editing a shipped file) and `bindings`, a list of rows. Row fields: `skill` (the profile entry name under skills/), `repo_path` (the source, relative to the repo root), `form` (`dir` when the skill is a DIRECTORY, `file` when it is a single law file at the repo root). A row MAY carry `loaded: false` plus a `reason` to record a law this factory deliberately does not bind; it is PRINTED as excused on every run and is never the same output as a bound row. LEG A, COVERAGE, is the load-bearing one: the gate DISCOVERS every `SKILL.md` the repo ships (pruning .git, TEMPLATE, .venv, node_modules, __pycache__), PRINTS the discovered set on every run, and REDs naming every discovered law file no row covers. It fires on BOTH admissible layouts — a root-level `SKILL.md` (a repo with no skills/ directory at all) and a `SKILL.md` inside a declared skill directory — and a discovered set of zero PRINTS as zero, so found-nothing is never a clean verdict. LEG B, FORWARD: every declared `repo_path` must exist and carry a `SKILL.md`. LEG C: every discovered law file is bound, or excused by a `loaded: false` row, or the gate REDs naming the path. THE LIVE PROFILE LEG IS NOT IN THIS GATE: no offline gate can reach a surface outside the tree, so the live binding (that the profile entry is a SYMLINK whose realpath equals the declared source, never a copy) is upheld by a PATROL with ONE named owner, whose product is a required section of the measurement artifact. This gate reads a profile root only when one is SUPPLIED via OC_HARNESS_PROFILE_ROOT (a fixture, or that patrol); with none supplied the profile leg is EXCUSED with its stated reason, never silently passed. An ABSENT declaration SKIPS with a stated reason — but ONLY when the tree ships no law file: a shipped law file with no declaration at all is a FAILURE naming the path, which is the whole gap this gate closes.
